name: Agency hero: an architectural drawing that drafts itself, then dimensions and annotates its own decisions
notes: Signature effect: a page layout drawn as an architect's plan that draws itself, then adds dimension lines and annotations explaining why each region exists. Every path carries pathLength="1" so one duration reads the same on a 40px tick and a 600px frame; without that the long paths crawl and the short ones snap. Timing is authored per path with --delay and --dur custom properties. Two things to know before editing: the annotation positions were fixed after measuring getBBox on the rendered text (two labels were colliding within 1px), so if you move one, re-measure rather than eyeballing it. And below 560px the drawing scales to about 0.55, which would render the 10px annotations at roughly 5px, so the .anno class is hidden and the viewBox crops to the page frame via JS (viewBox cannot be set from CSS). Nothing is lost there because all three annotations are also stated as a real numbered list in the copy. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
